could_not_check_models_reopen_the_detail: Could not check models. Reopen the details to retry.
update_the_backend_to_enable_the_new_mod: Update the backend to enable the new model selection.
backend_ready_extract_dll_310_9_16_to_ad: Backend ready. Extract DLL 310.9.16 to add the new model.
derived_from_310_9_16_faster_may_change_: Derived from 310.9.16 · faster, may change the image.
choose_the_mode_and_architecture_to_inst: Choose the mode and architecture to install or repair the mod in this game.
original_optiscaler_with_nr_plugin_dx11_: Original OptiScaler with NR plugin · DX11, DX12 and Vulkan · 64-bit. Requires DLSS, FSR or XeSS in game.
in_game_nr_menu_or_ctrl_f11: In game: NR menu or Ctrl+F11.
install_repair_replaces_the_game_s_nr_se: Install / repair replaces the game’s NR settings with backend defaults and the choices above.
for_installed_mods_start_enabled_and_ren: For installed mods, Start enabled and RenoDX save automatically for the next launch. Other options require installation or repair.
when_installing_or_repairing_the_backend: When installing or repairing, the backend downloads and installs LumeniteFX from its official project. Then switch in ReShade's Add-ons menu. If incompatible, the backend falls back to VORT.
default_option_already_bundled_with_the_: Default option, already bundled with the backend. Applied when installing or repairing.
the_nr_checkbox_starts_checked_when_laun: The NR checkbox starts checked when launching the game.
image_style_from_the_dlss_5_add_on: Image style from the DLSS 5 add-on.
available_only_with_the_old_model_310_8_: Available only with the old model (310.8.0).
in_game_press_end_to_adjust_nr_in_nr_con: In game, press End to adjust NR in NR Control. With backend 0.0.8.1 or newer, customize keys on the Hotkeys page.
end_opens_nr_control_with_renodx_enabled: End opens NR Control. With RenoDX enabled, NR settings move to that panel; OptiScaler keeps its upscaling and frame generation menu.
in_game_adjust_nr_in_the_reshade_menu_s_: In game, adjust NR in the ReShade menu’s Add-ons tab.
